shortDescription: Non-custodial wallet connections, verified chain status and Worldz proof.
fullDescriptionDraft:
WorldzApp is the first-party gateway to the WorldzEcosystem. Explore Worldz modules, inspect verified blockchain and treasury status, and connect supported external wallets without giving Worldz your seed phrase, recovery phrase or private key.

WorldzApp keeps identity, public chain reads, simulation, multisig evidence and transaction authority separate. One app does not mean one master wallet or universal signing key.

The current release focuses on public ecosystem navigation, verified read-only chain information, external non-custodial wallet connection, unsigned simulation status and public multisig/proof information. Capabilities that have not passed their own release gates are shown as gated rather than presented as live.

WorldzApp does not promise investment returns. App-level transaction signing, execution and mainnet broadcast remain disabled in this release.
truthRule: Store text and screenshots must describe only capabilities present in the exact submitted build. Gated roadmap features may not be portrayed as live.

commercialModel.publicWording: WorldzApp™ is a one-time A$2.50 purchase. After applicable platform fees, taxes, refunds and payment adjustments, Worldz intends to allocate net app-sale proceeds 50/50: 50% toward future Worldz ecosystem liquidity provisioning and 50% toward WorldzApp development, infrastructure and ongoing operations. Purchasing WorldzApp does not purchase tokens, LP ownership, an investment interest, revenue share, or any right to financial returns.
